description: Exploit insecure cross-window messaging (`window.postMessage`) — handlers that trust `event.data` without checking `event.origin`, leading to XSS, token theft, or state change. Load when the app uses iframes/popups/SSO widgets, on "postMessage", or when JS registers a `message` listener. Signals: `addEventListener("message", ...)`, embedded third-party frames, SSO/login popups.
